name: @omem/sdk
description: OMEM SDK: trustworthy memory for AI agents
//: `main` points at built ESM in dist/, produced by `npm run build`. It pointed at src/index.ts until there was a build step, which is why this package was marked private: publishing it would have shipped raw TypeScript that breaks on import for every plain-JS consumer, under a name then taken. The build exists now, so the guard is gone. The version stays behind sdk/python on purpose - this SDK does not yet cover the whole Python surface, and `npm test` reports what is missing.
